title: Intro to Finite State Machines

hints.title: How to write a switch statement on an enum
hints.content: Use `switch (state) { case IDLE: ... break; case RAISING: ... break; case HOLDING: ... break; }`. Each case handles the behavior for one specific state.

hints.title: How to transition between states
hints.content: To transition, reassign the state variable inside a case: `state = LiftState.RAISING;`. The next time the switch runs, it will enter the RAISING case instead of IDLE.

hints.title: Why two iterations?
hints.content: In a real program, the switch runs inside a `while(opModeIsActive())` loop. The first iteration detects the button press in IDLE and transitions to RAISING. The second iteration enters the RAISING case and sets the motor power. We simulate two loop iterations by writing the switch twice.

hints.title: Full solution structure
hints.content: Write the same switch statement twice. Both have three cases: IDLE (set power 0.0, check gamepad1.a to transition), RAISING (set power 1.0), and HOLDING (set power 0.1). The first switch transitions from IDLE to RAISING. The second switch enters RAISING and sets the motor to 1.0.
